“大伯的意思是我一下子加入内堂会引起他人的注意？”
“是！”许浩然点了点头说道：“突然进来一个炼气期一层的家族子弟，一定会引起他人的注意，如果老九他们肯调查的话，也不是一件很难的事情。”
“那我就从家族学院开始吧。”许紫烟略微想了一下说道。
“这不行，”许浩然苦笑了一下说道：“凭你炼气期一层的修为进入家族学院，那更引人瞩目。”
“这我自有办法！”
许紫烟此时正站在广场上的一群人的后面，这一群人都是许氏家族的十五岁以下的弟子，最小的只有三岁，最大的也不超过十五岁。因为超过十五岁的弟子要不就是突破了后天五层的修为进入了外堂，要不就是没有突破，被家族赶了出去，为家族做一些低贱的事情。
许紫烟如今虚岁十五，周岁还差两个月到十五。她被伪造了一个家族管事的远房侄女的身份进入了家族学院。给自己制作了一张敛息符，遮掩了自己的修为，把自己的修为遮掩在后天四层的水平。
站在一群大多数都是小屁孩的后面，许紫烟发呆般地跟着做着动作，出拳，踢腿……
刚进入家族学院的时候，许紫烟因为对修真知识的缺乏，还真是认真地听了几天传授师父授课。可是几天几天之后，许紫烟就已经完全理解了后天五层以下的修炼方法。毕竟在许紫烟的灵魂中有着一套完整的传承。虽然只是一套水系功法，但是这套水系功法却是极其的完整，内容也是极其的庞大。
许紫烟这些日子一直沉浸在那套水系功法水冰诀之中，她在修炼水冰诀中的一套名字叫作《水龙吟》的功法。其内容千头万绪，对于许紫烟这样一个从来没有接受过修真的人，并不是给你一套功法就能够一路修炼至巅峰的，它需要扎实的基础和广博的知识。而在学院里学到的这点儿知识明显不够许紫烟学习的。如此一来她就更加地渴望能够进入到家族中的藏书楼中翻阅那些秘笈。
这些日子，许紫烟已经拿着许浩然给她的钱分批分次地购买了大量草药，在晚上用自己制作的火灵符炼制了许多蕴灵丹。
每天上午跟着学院里的师父修炼之后，到了下午许紫烟便会独自呆在自己的屋子里服食着蕴灵丹修炼《水龙吟》。还要抽时间给家族每天制作五张纸符，许紫烟的日子过得很忙碌，同时也很充实。
就在昨天的晚上，许紫烟终于突破了炼气期第一层，达到了炼气期第二层的境界。所以，今天在操场上的修炼，许紫烟还沉浸在突破的欣喜当中，脑海中还在不停地思索着《水龙吟》的功法。
随着一声口令，许紫烟从思索中清醒了过来。授课师父将众人集中起来，威严地站在队伍的前面。他叫许智勇，一个后天十二层的武者。在家族学院中担任着许紫烟这个班级的授课师父。此时正目光冷厉地从每一个人的脸上扫过，声音洪亮地喝道：
“还有十天就是家族测试的时间，在你们当中有八个十五岁的弟子，如果你们在十天之后的测试中达不到后天五层，那么你们就是我们许家的耻辱，就要被赶出学院，去做低贱的事情。”
话音未落，许智勇的目光又在包括许紫烟在内的八个十五岁的弟子身上扫过。许紫烟也飞快地扫了一眼那七个已经达到十五岁的弟子，他们有五男两女。其中的三男一女的脸上透露出自豪的神情，一看即知这四个人应该已经达到了后天五层的修为。而剩下的两男一女的脸上却明显地透露着一片恢败。同时这七个人的目光也扫过了许紫烟，那四个突破的人，眼中透露出淡淡地不屑，而那三个没有突破的弟子则透露出同病相怜的神色。
许紫烟淡淡一笑，知道自己因为敛息符的原因，透露在外面只有后天第四层的修为，才致使众人都用着一种看待失败者的目光看着她，就是许智勇的目光也透露着不屑。因为虽然学院授课的时间只有上午，但是所有的弟子都在下午，甚至晚上主动地来到操场上加练，但是许智勇却从来没有看到许紫烟主动出现在操场上。
许紫烟已经来到学院一个月了，刚来到学院的时候，许智勇看到许紫烟有着后天四层的修为，心中还十分地高兴，认为自己的班级又会出现一个突破到后天第五层的人才。可是随着后来看到了许紫烟的表现，许智勇便失望了。但是还是忍着脾气找许紫烟谈了两次，但是每次谈完话之后，许紫烟依旧我行我素，让许智勇从失望到愤怒，最后再到对许紫烟的不屑，在心里他已经在许紫烟的身上打上了垃圾的标签。

"Uncle, you mean that if I join the inner hall all of a sudden, I will attract other people's attention?"
"Yes!" Xu Haoran nodded and said: "The sudden entry of a family member who is at the first level of Qi Refining will definitely attract the attention of others. If Lao Jiu and the others are willing to investigate, it will not be a difficult thing."
"Then I'll start from the family academy." Xu Ziyan thought for a moment and said.
"That won't work," Xu Haoran smiled bitterly and said, "It would be even more eye-catching to enter the family academy with your first-level cultivation at the Qi Refining Stage."
"I have my own way!"
Xu Ziyan was standing behind a group of people in the square at this time. This group of people were all disciples of the Xu family under the age of fifteen. The youngest was only three years old, and the oldest was no more than fifteen years old. Because disciples over the age of fifteen either broke through the fifth level of acquired cultivation and entered the outer hall, or else they failed to break through and were kicked out by the family and did some despicable things for the family.
Xu Ziyan is now fifteen years old, and is still two months shy of fifteen. She entered the family academy by pretending to be the distant niece of a family steward. He made himself a breath-containing charm to cover up his cultivation level, and concealed his cultivation level at the acquired fourth level.
Standing behind a group of mostly kids, Xu Ziyan followed the movements in a daze, punching, kicking...
When he first entered the family academy, Xu Ziyan really listened carefully to the master's lectures for a few days because of his lack of knowledge about cultivation. But after a few days, Xu Ziyan completely understood the cultivation methods below the fifth level. After all, there is a complete set of inheritance in Xu Ziyan's soul. Although it is only a set of water-based exercises, this set of water-based exercises is extremely complete and the content is extremely large.
Xu Ziyan has been immersed in the set of water-based skills, Water Ice Jue, these days. She is practicing a set of water-ice techniques called "Water Dragon Yin". The content is intricate. For a person like Xu Ziyan who has never accepted cultivation, it is not just a set of exercises that will allow you to practice all the way to the top. It requires a solid foundation and extensive knowledge. The little knowledge learned in the academy was obviously not enough for Xu Ziyan to learn. As a result, she was even more eager to enter the family library and read those secret books.
These days, Xu Ziyan has used the money Xu Haoran gave her to buy a large number of herbal medicines in batches, and used the fire spirit talisman she made to refine many spiritual pills at night.
After practicing with the master in the academy every morning, Xu Ziyan would stay alone in his room in the afternoon, taking the Soul-Yun Pill and practicing "Water Dragon Song". He also takes time to make five paper charms for his family every day. Xu Ziyan's life is very busy and fulfilling at the same time.
Just last night, Xu Ziyan finally broke through the first level of the Qi Refining Stage and reached the second level of the Qi Refining Stage. Therefore, during today's training on the playground, Xu Ziyan was still immersed in the joy of breakthrough, and was still thinking about the "Water Dragon Song" technique in his mind.
With a command, Xu Ziyan woke up from his thoughts. The teacher gathered everyone together and stood majestically at the front of the team. His name is Xu Zhiyong, a warrior of the acquired twelfth level. In the family college, he serves as the teacher of Xu Ziyan's class. At this time, his eyes were sternly scanning everyone's face, and he shouted in a loud voice:
"There are still ten days left for the family test. There are eight fifteen-year-old disciples among you. If you fail to reach the fifth level of the day after tomorrow in the test ten days later, then you will be a shame to our Xu family and will be kicked out of the academy to do lowly things."
Before he finished speaking, Xu Zhiyong's eyes were on the eight fifteen-year-olds including Xu Ziyan.Scanned over the disciples. Xu Ziyan also quickly glanced at the seven disciples who had reached the age of fifteen. There were five boys and two girls. Three men and one woman among them had proud expressions on their faces, and one could tell at a glance that these four people must have reached the fifth level of acquired cultivation. But the faces of the remaining two men and one woman clearly revealed a state of despair. At the same time, the eyes of these seven people also swept over Xu Ziyan. The four people who had made breakthroughs showed a touch of disdain in their eyes, while the three disciples who had not made breakthroughs showed signs of sympathy.
Xu Ziyan smiled faintly, knowing that because of the breath-holding talisman, she revealed that she only had the fourth level of cultivation outside, so everyone looked at her with a look at a loser. Even Xu Zhiyong's eyes also revealed disdain. Because although the college only teaches in the morning, all the disciples take the initiative to come to the playground to practice in the afternoon or even at night, but Xu Zhiyong has never seen Xu Ziyan take the initiative to appear on the playground.
Xu Ziyan has been in the academy for a month. When he first came to the academy, Xu Zhiyong was very happy when he saw that Xu Ziyan had the acquired fourth level of cultivation, thinking that there would be another talent in his class who could break through to the acquired fifth level. But when he saw Xu Ziyan's performance later, Xu Zhiyong became disappointed. But he still endured his temper and talked to Xu Ziyan twice, but after each conversation, Xu Ziyan still went his own way, making Xu Zhiyong go from disappointment to anger, and finally to disdain for Xu Ziyan. In his heart, he had already labeled Xu Ziyan as garbage.
